title: Electropaint 1994 (decompiled)
author: David A. Tristram
blurb: The OpenGL screensaver that ran on every idle IRIX screen, recovered by decompiling the MIPS binary: the famous default script with smooth HLS colour. M switches between the shipped look and the IRIS-faithful one.
port: The verbatim decompilation, built for comparison; the demo on exhibit is the readable version one directory up. Starts in the shipped 1994 look; M restores the IRIS GL look.
